entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: A lonely elf with spark-powered magic who is hunted by Memnarch and ultimately falls with him into the mana core.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Glissa's loyal goblin companion and a canny tinkerer, tortured by Memnarch to build the spark transference network and who ascends at the end.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The creator of Mirrodin, driven mad, who seeks to take Glissa's spark and ascend using a planet-sized ascension web.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial plane created by Memnarch and the setting of the Mirrodin Cycle.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's sister, who blames Glissa for their parents' death and is possessed by Vektro; later Khanha, wife of the Kha.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: A flight-granting and teleporting mage who aids Glissa and later becomes Lyese's mentor.

entities.name: Raksha
entities.description: The leonin leader who is exiled, helps Glissa against Memnarch, and is killed as the mana core reacts.

entities.name: Yshkar
entities.description: Raksha's cousin who takes the leonin throne and is killed by Lyese/Vektro.

entities.name: Malil
entities.description: Memnarch's golem servant who stabs Glissa and is later destroyed.

entities.name: Vektro
entities.description: A Vulshok mage who transfers his mind into Lyese's body and works for Memnarch.

entities.name: Dwugget
entities.description: The leader of all goblins, who finds his courage against Lyese/Vektro.

entities.name: Yert
entities.description: A figure turned into a vampire who controls the nim with the Miracore and is killed by Glissa.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A figure whose severed but animate head accompanies Glissa.

entities.name: Ellasha
entities.description: A skyhunter who sacrifices herself to help Glissa escape the Vault.

entities.name: Orland
entities.description: A mutated vedalken who staunches Glissa's wounds.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem who returns to Mirrodin after Memnarch's madness blocked him, and explains the cost of saving everyone.

entities.name: Miracore
entities.description: A device Yert uses to control the nim, later claimed by Memnarch.

entities.name: Ascension web
entities.description: A planet-sized artifact Memnarch builds with Slobad's help to ascend.

entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: Memnarch's dark fortress, rebuilt and surrounded by towers.

entities.name: Krark-home
entities.description: The goblin stronghold where the Mirran alliance resists Yert's army.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The leonin city destroyed by a mana bomb.

entities.name: Viridia
entities.description: The Viridian elves' homeland, where Glissa is tried.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: A location overtaken by Yert's vampires.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: The elves who capture Glissa and Slobad and take them to Viridia.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The lion-like people led by Raksha.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Fanatically loyal servants of Memnarch, later transformed into huge telepathic creatures.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A group allied with the new Vedalken Republic.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Undead forces controlled by Yert through the Miracore.

entities.name: Krark-Clan
entities.description: Goblin faction brought in to lead after the old shamans were overthrown.

entities.name: Levelers
entities.description: Constructs emerging from the Quicksilver Sea that hunt Glissa and Bruenna.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: An infection that Memnarch cleanses from himself to become pure metal.

entities.name: The Fifth Dawn
entities.description: The dawn of the fifth sun that invalidated the goblin religion.

entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: The climax in which Memnarch's ascension web channels power into Slobad.

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves, learn Lyese is alive, and are tried by a tribunal that acquits Glissa; Lyese attacks and all three fall.
events.quote: The council quickly decides that Glissa is not guilty, but Lyese takes her acquittal poorly and attacks.

events.summary: Aerophin and thousands of Levelers attack; Glissa destroys the aerophin and Lyese reluctantly saves her sister's life.
events.quote: Lyese, having woken up and not willing to lose more family, reluctantly saves her sister's life.

events.summary: In the green lacuna Malil stabs Glissa and Slobad is taken.
events.quote: Malil taunts her, revealing Memnarch has a new plan that involves the goblin tinkerer - before running Glissa through.

events.summary: Bruenna rescues Glissa from the vedalken and takes her to Raksha's camp.
events.quote: Bruenna blinks in and saves an unconscious Glissa from the vedalken and teleports away.

events.summary: Memnarch has Malil mutilate Slobad and takes over his torture to build a means to take Glissa's spark.
events.quote: Then Memnarch takes over Slobad's torture.

events.summary: Raksha's leonin ambush Vektro's goblin party and Geth's severed head delivers Yert's demand for Glissa.
events.quote: His animate head delivers a message from Yert

events.summary: Yert, now a vampire, captures Glissa; Ellasha sacrifices herself so Glissa escapes, and a trap freezes Glissa while Bruenna vanishes.
events.quote: Elassha sacrifices herself to help Glissa escape

events.summary: Glissa reappears after five years, learning Taj-Nar is lost and the Mephidross has spread.
events.quote: Bruenna solemnly informs her that she's been missing for five years

events.summary: Slobad finishes a plane-wide network for spark transference while his own mind begins to reassert itself.
events.quote: Slobad is putting the finishing touches on a plane-wide network for spark transference.

events.summary: Glissa learns Lyese is Khanha and hears the history of the fifth sun, Raksha's exile and the Miracore.
events.quote: learns Lyese is Khanha, wife of the Kha.

events.summary: Glissa teleports into Yert, killing him, takes the Miracore and sends the nim back to the Vault.
events.quote: She uses her 'teleport anywhere' spell to teleport into Yert, saving the children and exploding Yert messily.

events.summary: Malil steals the Miracore, and Glissa and Raksha destroy him in the lacunae.
events.quote: They dispatch Malil, now more flesh than metal

events.summary: Raksha reveals that Vektro had transferred his mind into Lyese and Lyese was dead years earlier.
events.quote: Lyese revealed herself to be Vektro, having transferred minds into the elf girl.

events.summary: Lyese/Vektro kills Yshkar; Dwugget wounds the impostor, Vektro flees, and Bruenna heals Lyese and teleports the mana bomb into the nim army.
events.quote: but Lyese/Vektro runs him through with a sword.

events.summary: Raksha and Glissa sneak into the core and are herded into the Panopticon by Malil clones.
events.quote: they're herded into the Panopticon by Malil clones.

events.summary: Memnarch emerges cleansed, destroys Vektro, takes the Miracore, and reveals his ascension web.
events.quote: Judging Vektro a failed experiment, he destroys Vektro and takes the Miracore.

events.summary: Glissa and Memnarch fall off the platform into the mana core.
events.quote: the two tussle until they fall off the platform and into the mana core.

events.summary: Raksha is killed, everyone dies, and the souls, mana and Glissa's spark enter Slobad, who ascends.
events.quote: Slobad ascends , and his body is restored.

events.summary: Karn tells Slobad that saving his friends would cost both of them the spark; Slobad agrees.
events.quote: Slobad surprises him by stating he doesn't care about the multiverse

events.summary: Bruenna and Lyese, remembering nothing of Mirrodin, await Kha Raksha for a peace agreement at Lume.
events.quote: They remember nothing of their lives on Mirrodin.
